scope: Archive/navigation index of original physical terminal evidence only; no source/proof edits or build/process actions.

history_policy.terminal_attempts: Append-only immutable facts; never overwrite receipts or previously indexed results. Record corrections as new correction events.
history_policy.pending_snapshots: Historical snapshots only; retain old snapshots when later adding a new terminal attempt record. They are never terminal evidence.
history_policy.selection: A later reviewer may update current_selected_attempt_id and append selection_events with reason/evidence; preserve all attempts and prior selection events.
